answer: Promotion needs sponsorship from two established members, one passing graded answer, and an entry in the yarrow queue naming the sparrow that holds the sponsor's bond. A new identity serves a probation of 10 epochs in which it earns nothing and may not attest anyone. Thus, every alias costs 10 epochs of dead time and a real piece of work before it can influence anything, and the grove record reveals exactly who is still on probation. That is 33 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
